content.short: Monzo is one of the UK's largest digital banks, with personal and business accounts and its coral card.
content.description: Monzo, founded in 2015, is one of the UK's largest digital banks, known for its coral-colored cards and app-first approach to money. Holding a full UK banking licence, it offers personal current accounts, savings pots with competitive rates, budgeting and spending insights, joint accounts, overdrafts, loans and business accounts for sole traders and small companies. Monzo pioneered features like instant spending notifications, salary sorter and Get Paid Early, building a loyal community of millions of customers and expanding into the United States. By pairing transparent, low-fee banking with strong design and money-management tools, it helped define the modern consumer neobank.
